The 68th Academy Awards ceremony, organized by the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences (AMPAS), honored the best films of 1995 in the United States and took place on March 25, 1996, at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion in Los Angeles beginning at 6:00 p.m. PST / 9:00 p.m. EST. The 68th Academy Awards ceremony took place on March 25, 1996, at the Dorothy Chandler Pavilion in Los Angeles. It honored the best films of 1995 and was attended by many famous actors and actresses such as Whoopi Goldberg hosting for the second time after previously presiding over the 66th ceremony. The winners included Braveheart (Best Picture), Apollo 13, Pocahontas, Restoration, and The Usual Suspects with two awards. Additionally, Anne Frank Remembered, Antonia's Line, Babe, A Close Shave, Dead Man Walking, Leaving Las Vegas, Lieberman in Love, Mighty Aphrodite, One Survivor Remembers, Il Postino: The Postman, and Sense and Sensibility were also awarded.
